en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a hilltop circular mausoleum/ossuary with a domed roof and colonnaded upper section, surrounded by trees and vegetation. In the foreground, there is a dirt path, stone benches, and a person seated under a large tree looking toward the monument. Mountains are faintly visible in the background. The printed caption at the bottom identifies the location.
